vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes are opened immediately, at the lowest fixing version, and routed by renovate-triage.yml (CVSS). The package is a published library: a fixed dependency keeps its range (bump of the floor), never an exact pin that would force one version on every consumer.

lockFileMaintenance.description: package-lock.json only pins the dev and test tree (consumers resolve their own): a weekly re-lock keeps its transitive dependencies fresh.

customManagers.description: Keeps the Requirements of README.md in sync with the peerDependencies and engines of package.json: each line carries a hidden marker naming the dependency, so both files move in the same PR.

packageRules.description: Batch routine updates once a week, instead of the daily Dependabot PRs.
algoan/renovate-security-actions runs the Renovate triage: its updates come in their own PR, for a human review.
